title: User Registration
user_story: As a new user, I want to register with my personal details so that I can create an account.
acceptance_criteria: User can register with valid details
Mandatory fields cannot be left blank
manual_test_cases: Verify successful registration with valid details
Verify registration fails when email already exists
Verify validation messages for mandatory fields
Verify confirmation message after successful registration
Verify user cannot register with an invalid email format
generated_test_cases:
Feature: User Registration

Scenario: Successful registration with valid details
Given a user is on the registration page
When the user enters valid personal details
And enters a unique email address
And enters a password meeting complexity requirements
And clicks the register button
Then the user is registered successfully
And a registration confirmation message is displayed
